system_thesis_interpretation: Scientific verdict: PASS for proposal-stage deliberation, with no unresolved scientific ambiguity and no execution authority. V6 implements exactly the three repairs required by the V5 consensus: every prerequisite is moved to the universal pre-model boundary, the mandatory review pair is one fresh independent implementation reviewer plus one separate author-side scientific advocate over identical bytes, and the selector receives a deterministic immutable four-commit adapter receipt. The complete V4 scientific protocol and all four V5 systems repairs remain in force by verified exact hashes. The experiment still asks only whether isolated target-masked LoRA writes can carry complementary, correctness-selected, child-authored endpoint policies over sixteen seen tool-by-mode keys per engineered root without exceeding four prespecified spill-family limits. THINK remains provenance for endpoints already achieved by the child, DREAM still projects only visible tool, visible mode, a neutral endpoint frame, and the exact final ACT, and SLEEP remains the same supervised matched-complement write. V6 changes no model, tokenizer rule, source data, training row, dose, rank, recipe, workload, estimator, threshold, label, or permitted reading. It creates no present scientific result and no claim about autonomous credit assignment, outcome-token causality, the causal value of child authorship, reasoning-path learning, unseen-key generalization, arbitrary capacity, retention, qualification, parenting, C11, population inference, or the organism as a whole.
graph_delta_interpretation: The scientific intervention graph is unchanged from the hash-bound V4/V5 base. R0 and R1 remain engineered-disjoint robustness roots rather than population samples; each retains 24 candidate tools in two fixed orientation strata, two modes, correctness-paired mirror-world admission, lowest-ordinal selection of four tools per stratum, sixteen selected keys, exact M+/M- complement assignments, and isolated W+/W- fits against OFF. The lifecycle, three dispatchers, selected-only dereference, and global-versus-root source-boundary nodes restate the four V5 systems repairs rather than introduce new scientific variables. V6's new construction edge is the four-commit receipt: the barrier emits one immutable canonical ordered set of the four exact root, condition, adapter identity, COMMITTED-state, and adapter-hash bindings; the selector reads that derived receipt without adapter content or capability, rejects missing, stale, duplicate, unexpected, aliased, mismatched, or non-committed bindings, and copies the exact identity/hash into every non-OFF selected execution call while leaving OFF adapter-free. This closes adapter provenance at execution-call construction without changing prompts, targets, conditions, seeds, model-visible information, evaluation membership, or any contrast being estimated.
loop_delta_interpretation: The causal and temporal loop remains V4 plus the total V5 execution plumbing: freeze identities, maps, templates, parser, seeds, estimands, thresholds, and workload; materialize and seal the complete candidate-local evaluation bank before source; acquire the fixed two-emission source trajectories without semantic retry; reduce paired correctness eligibility and select lowest ordinals; compile byte-exact successful final ACTs with read-only admission; prove complement and fit geometry; under later authority fit and hash-commit four separate adapters; construct the ordered four-commit receipt; select and hash-verify only admitted bank entries; execute immutable bound calls through phase-minimal dispatchers; and reduce immutable results one way. The five run statuses and per-root SOURCE_INVALID eligibility remain the exact V5 partition, so inter-stage states stay RUNNING and an untouched root cannot receive a fabricated scientific label. V6 strengthens only the pre-execution gate: all T01-T07 receipts, the immutable execution manifest, the distinct T08 reviewer and advocate PASS artifacts on identical bytes, and a separate exact human execution ratification must precede every model-facing invocation on every device, including CPU. The advocate cannot override an independent rejection. Partial execution, a failed receipt, or either missing PASS remains non-evidence and cannot be rescued by pooling roots, replacing a root, changing dose or rank, or reclassifying an infrastructure stop as science.
claim_delta_interpretation: The future claim and every numerical invariant are unchanged. Each adapter still has 128 target-masked items, the four fits still total at most 262,144 training token-passes, and the selected run remains bounded at 5,056 emissions, 102,400 generated tokens, and 1,536 teacher-forced candidate sequence scores. Optimization still requires every midpoint median paired held-target gain d_s(k) to be at least 0.50 and the absolute W+/W- mean-gain difference to be at most 0.25. Oracle strict accuracy remains at least 0.90 by root, map, and stratum; fitted own-map strict validity remains at least 0.95 overall and 0.875 per stratum; own-map generated balanced accuracy remains at least 0.80 with at least 0.75 accuracy per orientation stratum. The per-key directional q conjunction must still hold on at least 12/16 keys and 6/8 per stratum, mean_I must be at least 1.00, the fixed-panel 3,277th of 65,536 ordered resample means must be strictly positive, mirrored tau must be at least 0.50, and mirrored gain g must be at least 0.20. Each prespecified spill family's signed legal-ACT-presence increase and equal-prompt conditional-action TV remain at most 0.05. Parser overlays, fixed denominators, binary64 accumulation and logsumexp, hexadecimal thresholds, comparison equality, non-finite precedence, reducer ordering, seven root labels, scientific_pair, and run_pass are untouched. Thus a future two-root pass still supports only conditional supervised endpoint-policy carriage on correctness-selected seen keys with bounded behavior on four named control families; it does not imply every key passed, global absence of spill, population generalization, or any current result. V6 adds the three repaired gate receipts to claim eligibility but does not alter the estimand or widen the reading.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: The V6 matrix is the same complete 11-information-item by 15-stage Cartesian product established in V5: 165 unique cells, with no missing, duplicate, or unknown pair. A direct V5-to-V6 comparison finds no visibility-value change in any cell. The sole reason-text change is adapter_stage_state at trusted_evaluation_selector, which remains derived_only and now explicitly limits the selector to the immutable canonical four-commit receipt and exact non-OFF identity/hash copying. The barrier alone reads the four adapter identities, states, and hashes; the selector receives neither adapter content nor loading capability; generators still receive only prompt or continuation byte projections; and the evaluation dispatcher reads exactly one immutable selected_execution_call rather than direct maps, admission, bank, prompt, training, history, adapter-state, prior-result, or scorer objects. OFF remains adapter-free. Consequently the receipt repair supplies the missing provenance edge without exposing new scientific information or reopening selection, reseeding, reconditioning, reordering, mutation, feedback, alias, log, exception, filename, cache, or unselected-bank paths.
acceptance_test_interpretation: MWG6_T01 preserves all V4 materialization, identity, seed, bank, geometry, and workload checks, retains V5 immutable dispatcher-envelope checks, and adds exact receipt construction and non-OFF identity/hash copying. MWG6_T02 preserves the complete 165-cell visibility product and adversarially tests every receipt mutation together with ingress, feedback, alias, log, exception, cache, filename, selected-only dereference, and unselected-content denials. MWG6_T03 retains V5's exhaustive separation of global source_started from each root's own first-source receipt. MWG6_T04 runs the complete complement, target, mask, order, seed, node, optimizer, and fit-geometry invariant unchanged. MWG6_T05 runs the total raw-byte parser and all stage overlays unchanged. MWG6_T06 retains every exact numerical and label fixture while preserving V5's exactly-one status cases across all inter-stage checkpoints. MWG6_T07 retains path, retry, capability, foreign-root isolation, dispatcher, residual-RUNNING, selected-only, and untouched-root faults and adds fail-closed receipt corruption cases. MWG6_T08 restores the exact fresh-independent-reviewer plus separate-author-side-scientific-advocate pair, requires both to inspect identical immutable implementation, manifest, and T01-T07 bytes, prevents advocate override, and leaves further reviewers additive only. Every T01-T08 record is now required before model_execution, and the normative trigger additionally requires all T01-T07 receipts, the immutable manifest, both T08 PASS artifacts, and separate exact human execution ratification before any model-facing invocation on any device. These static interpretation checks verified proposal schema, all six bound context hashes, the 165-cell product, zero V5-to-V6 visibility-value changes, and the universal required_before labels; they did not run the unauthorized deterministic suite or invoke a model, tokenizer, trainer, source, benchmark, adapter, subprocess, device, network, or GPU.
assumptions: The exact-hash inheritance and preservation clauses are normative: the cumulative V5 graph nodes restated in V6 do not reopen or replace any V4 scientific parameter, estimator, threshold, parser, workload, reducer, label, exclusion, or claim boundary.

The immutable canonical four-commit receipt has one predeclared order over the four exact root-by-fitted-condition bindings, and the later manifest may instantiate concrete adapter identities and hashes only within that order; runtime outcomes cannot choose or alter the order.

Trial-level ERROR or TRUNCATED observations assigned to fixed denominators remain distinct from stage-level infrastructure or evaluation failures, exactly as in V4/V5; the receipt repair does not permit denominator observations to be reclassified as lifecycle stops or vice versa.
